reviewNotes: HOLD / canonical-backstage. Current A1 first-party material resolves the old 12-vs-13-month conflict: B.free remains active for a maximum 13 months without a qualifying top-up, and one EUR20 top-up extends validity another 13 months. Foreign acquisition/first activation and long-term non-EU continuity remain unverified.

data.acquisitionSummary: A1 currently sells B.free as physical SIM or eSIM with online/shop acquisition. Current B.free S service is listed at EUR 9.90 per 28 days, but this review does not treat the tariff fee as a separately verified bare starter-SIM landed cost.

keep.action: A single top-up of at least EUR 20 extends B.free SIM validity by another 13 months. Two separate EUR 10 top-ups do not qualify for that extension.

data.chinaActivation: A new B.free prepaid SIM must be identity-registered before activation. A1 supports online FotoIdent, but foreign-country purchase/first activation is not established here.
data.kyc: Prepaid identity registration is mandatory. A1 supports photo ID through FotoIdent and other Austrian identification methods.
data.payment: A1 documents online top-up by card/online payment plus vouchers and ATMs.
data.refund: Remaining prepaid credit may be claimed after contract end under A1 conditions; a EUR20 processing fee is documented.
data.holdReason: Retention rule is current and clear, but foreign acquisition/first activation and long-term non-EU continuity are not verified.
data.tariffSummary: Top up EUR20 in one transaction to extend SIM validity by 13 months; identity registration required.
guideSteps: Acquire a current B.free physical SIM or eSIM and complete required identity registration.
Before the 13-month validity ends, top up at least EUR20 in one transaction.
Do not assume two EUR10 top-ups or unverified overseas-first activation provide the same lifecycle result.
